members.name: Alvorraia
members.role: Abre caminho quando a água avança, elevando parceiros sobre obstáculos.
members.palette: turquesa, coral, marfim e índigo; olhos violeta
members.prompt:
Create ONE new original adult Soulmonsters aquatic creature for a group called Quatro Mares. This is a distinct individual, not an evolution of reference. Our OWN attached approved art is ONLY a guide to clean 2D manga drawing and living-kite construction; DO NOT copy its species, face, horns, palette, crystal or anatomy. 45% expressive creature,45% real functional kite construction,10% bold dark selective stepped pixel-like contour and 2D manga finish. Body itself is broad smooth taut paper volumes, bamboo ribs and knot hinges with few large compression folds; no twisted flesh, realistic animal skin or all-over tiny origami triangles. Rich colored armor and deliberate large/medium/small detail hierarchy, matte flat cel colors with TWO hard shadow tones, no glossy 3D/gradient/paint texture. Strong adult presence and coherently rooted limbs/fins, one full soul-rabiola. Do NOT put Crystal Pipa in these concepts; their shared emblem is a braided tide-knot. FULL body on plain WHITE landscape canvas, generous 8% margins around ALL extremities, no text, montage, water background or extra figures. 
ADULT Alvorraia, incoming-tide guardian: an immense original manta-like living kite creature, NO legs, TWO broad swept pectoral sail fins rising in a powerful asymmetric lifting gesture, integrated short forward cephalic lobes made from TWO curled bamboo-and-paper guide vanes, not ears/horns. Small mature angular ray face on front body fold with narrow violet eyes, flat folded jaw and subtle gill-like paper slots, not bird beak/dragon head. Broad central diamond-bellied body made of ivory tensioned paper with coral and turquoise currents painted in big graphical forms; indigo lower sail plane. Bamboo leading spars grow from actual fin roots, coral-edged layered shoulder armor, matte copper sparse corner clamps, functional tide-knot at keel (a BRAIDED KNOT, NOT A GEM). Fins are several huge structured cut-paper vanes, not natural leathery skin or bird feathers. ONE long slim braided rear soul-rabiola, replacing ordinary sting tail, ends a coral/ivory fan flag, full root visible. Surface-powerful adult presence, compact body, long wide wings with clear left/right origins. Few connected splash-like PAPER edge shapes, no actual water effects hiding anatomy.
